LRT.Title: Long Rest Tracker
LRT.ReportFailed: Long rest records were saved, but the private chat report could not be created.
LRT.AutoHint: Record the current world time when a player-owned character completes a D&D5e long rest, including from its character sheet. Short rests and cancelled rests are ignored.
LRT.AutoFailed: The long rest completed, but automatic tracking failed. Ask the GM to record it manually.
LRT.RecordGMOnly: Only the GM can manually record a long rest.
LRT.RecordFailed: Could not record a rest for: {names}. Actor ownership is required.
LRT.NoActors: No accessible player-owned character tokens found on this scene.
LRT.Select: Select characters on the current scene.
LRT.Failed: Long Rest Tracker failed. See the browser console for details.
LRT.GMOnly: Only the GM can change the cooldown.
LRT.CooldownSaved: Long rest cooldown set to {hours} calendar hours.
LRT.InvalidCooldown: Enter a finite, non-negative number of hours.
LRT.Intro: Record completed rests or check player characters on the current scene.
LRT.SettingHint: Minimum calendar hours between completed long rests. Only the GM can change this world setting.
LRT.MenuHint: Record and check long rests on the current scene.
LRT.ShortRestHint: Start a two-minute countdown when the first character clicks Short Rest. Show who has clicked and who has not; the GM decides whether to advance one calendar hour. Individual D&D5e time advancement is suppressed.
LRT.ShortRestQuestion: Advance the clock by one hour?
LRT.ShortRestAdvanced: World clock advanced by one calendar hour.
LRT.ShortRestFailed: Group short-rest tracking failed. Check the console and world clock before retrying.
LRT.ShortRestUncertain: A previous group short-rest clock update was interrupted. Check the world clock. Automatic retry is disabled to avoid advancing twice.
LRT.LongRestHint: Start group tracking when the first character clicks Long Rest. Show who has clicked and who has not. Advance eight calendar hours once every tracked character completes their sheet rest. Individual D&D5e time advancement is suppressed.
LRT.LongRestQuestion: Waiting for everyone to complete their long rest before advancing eight hours.
LRT.LongRestAdvanced: World clock advanced by eight calendar hours.
LRT.LongRestFailed: Group long-rest tracking failed. Check the console and world clock before retrying.
LRT.LongRestUncertain: A previous group long-rest clock update was interrupted. Check the world clock. Automatic retry is disabled to avoid advancing twice.
LRT.ClockSourceHint: Automatically use an active Simple Calendar or Simple Calendar Reborn, otherwise Foundry’s built-in world clock. Calendar integration must allow world-time synchronization.
LRT.ClockMultipleCalendars: Both Simple Calendar variants are enabled. Disable one before using rest clock coordination.
LRT.ClockUnavailable: The selected calendar module is inactive or its API is not ready. Enable it or choose Automatic / Foundry in Long Rest Tracker settings.
LRT.ClockInvalidUnits: The selected calendar has invalid time units. Check its hours, minutes, and seconds configuration.
LRT.ClockIntegrationRequired: Enable Mixed or Third Party game-world-time integration in Simple Calendar / Reborn before advancing a group rest. Isolated calendars cannot synchronize the world clock.
LRT.ClockNotSynchronized: Simple Calendar and Foundry world time differ. Synchronize them in the calendar settings before advancing a group rest.
LRT.ClockSyncUncertain: The calendar accepted the time change, but world-clock synchronization could not be confirmed. Inspect both clocks before dismissing this group window; automatic retry is disabled.
LRT.ClockChangeRejected: The calendar rejected the time change. Check calendar permissions and settings before retrying.
LRT.ClockGMOnly: Only a GM can advance the group rest clock.
LRT.RestCoordinationHint: Coordinate party short and long rests and their shared clock advances. Turn off to stop group windows and countdowns and let D&D5e handle time normally. Long-rest recording and cooldown checks remain available. Pending group windows are cancelled.
LRT.ClockInvalidTime: The world clock has an invalid time value. Check the calendar and world clock before advancing a group rest.
LRT.LongRestRecordsFailed: The clock advanced, but the shared long-rest timestamp could not be saved for: {names}. Record those rests manually; do not advance the clock again.
LRT.RemainingGMOnly: Only the GM can change the party’s remaining long-rest cooldown.
LRT.RemainingHint: Set the shared cooldown for the whole party. Enter 0 to make everyone eligible now. This does not change the world clock or individual rest history.
LRT.RemainingRange: Enter a number from 0 to {hours} calendar hours. Decimals are allowed; 6.5 means six and a half calendar hours.
LRT.RemainingFailed: The party cooldown could not be saved. Check your GM permissions and clock settings.
LRT.RemainingSaved: The whole party has {hours} calendar hours remaining until the next long rest is eligible.
LRT.PartyRecordHint: Recording a long rest here resets the shared party cooldown for everyone. Selected characters also receive individual history records.
LRT.PartyClockSaveFailed: The party cooldown could not be saved. Use Set Party Time Remaining to correct it; do not advance the world clock again.
LRT.PartyStatusHint: Eligibility and time remaining use the same party cooldown for every character; individual rest history may differ.
